headline: Syrah Resources Reports Q3 Production Growth Amid Mounting Cost Pressures
summary: Graphite producer Syrah Resources achieved strong output gains in its third-quarter update, though performance met rising cost pressures.
why: Syrah Resources is a major Australian natural graphite developer supplying battery anode material supply chains worldwide.

impacts.name: Syrah Resources
impacts.why: Strong volume production growth was offset by persistent operating cost headwinds.
